problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: volume 64 cubic feet
* Package Beta: volume 56 cubic feet
* Package Gamma: volume 37 cubic feet
* Package Delta: volume 35 cubic feet
* Package Epsilon: volume 67 cubic feet
* Package Zeta: volume 59 cubic feet
* Package Eta: volume 50 cubic feet
* Package Theta: volume 41 cubic feet
* Package Iota: volume 48 cubic feet
* Package Kappa: volume 45 cubic feet
* Package Lambda: volume 70 cubic feet
* Package Mu: volume 57 cubic feet
* Package Nu: volume 48 cubic feet
* Package Xi: volume 32 cubic feet
* Package Omicron: volume 31 cubic feet
* Package Pi: volume 30 cubic feet
* Package Rho: volume 70 cubic feet
* Package Sigma: volume 47 cubic feet
* Package Tau: volume 34 cubic feet
* Package Upsilon: volume 50 cubic feet
* Package Phi: volume 50 cubic feet
* Package Chi: volume 65 cubic feet
* Package Psi: volume 48 cubic feet
* Package Omega: volume 33 cubic feet

Each truck can carry up to 100 cubic feet of cargo. Load all packages using the fewest trucks. Every package must be placed in exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot surpass its capacity.
